title: Lakeside Cemeteries in the Sahara: 5000 Years of Holocene Population and Environmental Change (Sereno and others, 2008)

source.license: CC BY (Creative Commons Attribution License, as stated in the PDF and on the PLoS ONE page)

summary: Describes about two hundred burials at Gobero, on the edge of a palaeolake in Niger, covering human occupation of the southern Sahara from about 8000 BCE and its change under severe climate swings.

tool.name: PageIndex
tool.method: PageIndex Flash mode run through Claude Code (claude-code/haiku; doc_id pi-4c64cee9af92415da94ba4952c56264e; store in out/pageindex). The tree follows the paper's own headings. I replaced PageIndex's model-written summaries, which contained numbers I could not stand behind, with short summaries of what each section covers, and tidied titles. Text is the PDF text layer by page.
